install.userOwnedExclusion: Only managed pipeline artifacts are removed on uninstall: the installer-managed skill tree (when marked) and commands matching pipeline:*.md. Unrelated user command files and non-pipeline skill content are preserved.
install.postInstall: Exec pipeline <verb> from the installed CLI. Live-detected this session (no restart).

early_run_handoff.how: Parse durable run handoff JSON from stdout (kind loop_run_handoff / run handoff) for run_id and absolute events path before first item dispatch.

event_follow.how: pipeline logs <run-id> --events --follow (or loop logs) until terminal; default until-terminal exits 0 after run_complete / loop_run_complete / loop_run_stopped.

reattach.how: Re-arm Monitor / event follow after cancelled or lost wait in the same harness turn; cancelled wait is not terminal.

wait_cancel.how: A cancelled Monitor, wait timeout, or session pause is never classified as run_complete or loop terminal success; re-arm follow until terminal evidence.

material_progress_notify.how: Monitor on material-filtered events; call PushNotification on each material one-liner.
material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout material lines via events.jsonl piped through material-filter.mjs

terminal_cleanup.how: Stop Monitors/follows for this run_id (and dual-follow advance streams) in the same turn as terminal exit; leave run store intact.

terminal_summary.how: Surface terminal JSON from pipeline single / loop; optional pipeline summary <run-id> and loop --audit.
